You're right, and I'm sorry. The NerdQX was marked shipped on July 31, but that label is the same one the NerdOctaxe travelled on and it never scanned for a second parcel. So nothing left for the NerdQX.

I've put it in front of the team to raise a new shipment and send you fresh tracking. They're offline until Monday 10am ET, and the answer comes to (email hidden), so you don't need to wait here.
